item.tib: sangs rgyas thugs las sprul pa'i gnas mchog bon ri chen po'i rtogs brjod nam mkha'i rnga sgra
item.coloph: ces pa'i tshul 'di yang 'jig rten la chen gsum du khyad par 'phags pa'i thugs spal bon ri chen po'i rtogs brjod 'di nyid sdug 'byung dad pa'i nges shes snying nas smin te bdag cag gi ston pa skye ba bzhes nasaM mi lo nyis khri chig stong brgyad brgya zhe drug 'das pa'i/ 'phags yul gyi skad du pra b+ha ba/ ma ha tsi Na bing zhu/ bod kyis zil gnon dbang thang dang bstun na me pho rta'i lo phyogs dus kyi gnas chen 'dus pa'i dus chen/ 'bras ldan hor zla brgyad pa'i dkar phyogs su mdo khams zal mo sgang du skyes shing phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i rgyal ba'i bstan pa la 'dun pa'i/ slob dpon mkhas grub lung rtogs rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i gnas mchog pho brang gi yang rtse byang chub shing gi nags khrod du kun gyi mig gi brgyan du spel ba 'dis kyang 'gro kun rnam dkar snang ba bskyed pa'i mthun rkyen du gyur cig
